meta.title: I tried the 2-minute rule for 30 days — here's what happened
meta.creator: Maya Rivers

transcript: Okay stop scrolling — this changed my entire routine. For thirty days I did the two minute rule. If a task takes under two minutes, I do it right now. Reply to that text, put the dish in the sink, send the email. The first week was rough. I kept forgetting. But by day ten something clicked. My phone stopped buzzing with reminders. My desk stayed clean. And here's the part nobody talks about — momentum. Once you start, you keep going. By day twenty I was finishing whole projects in one sitting. Day thirty I ran the numbers. I had shipped four blog posts, two client pitches, and reorganized my entire filing system. All from doing tiny things immediately. So if you're drowning in little stuff, try this. It costs nothing and it takes less time than watching this video. Comment 'two' if you're starting tonight.
